pure-announcement.rationale: This is GitHub's own changelog entry announcing a public-preview feature, consisting of enablement steps and an endpoint path, with no transferable idea developed beyond the product itself — the auditability theme it instantiates is not articulated here.

duplicate.rationale: siem-agentic-visibility-gap and proxy-boundary-session-capture cover the surrounding problem, but neither contains this specific vendor capability, so the note is not a duplicate — it is disqualified on other grounds.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Every claim is checkable against GitHub's linked documentation and the live product setting.

durability.rationale: The 'public preview' status, the AI Controls settings path, and the 48-hour-window endpoint are launch-day specifics that will be stale within months even though the underlying capability will persist in some form.

actionability.rationale: Its only actions are product-only toggles — select 'Enable everywhere' twice and call one REST endpoint — applicable solely to GitHub Enterprise Cloud EMU customers.

atomicity.rationale: It communicates exactly one thing: Copilot agent session data is now streamable and pullable for enterprises.
